basis: The chart shows a consistent and significant downward trend in the District Heating Demand Index from 24.0°C in 2005 to 10.0°C in 2015, indicating a substantial decrease over the full period. The public task requires routing based on whether this full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, and the magnitude of the decline (14.0°C) suggests it exceeds ordinary variation.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change to substantial-change follow-up
